title: add_subtitles arguments
description: Burn subtitles into a video from caller-supplied cues, an SRT/VTT string, or automatic speech-to-text transcription. Use when the user asks to add captions, subtitles, on-screen dialogue, or burned-in lyrics to a video. Pass `cues` as an array of {startSeconds, endSeconds, text}, pass a full `srt` string, or set `auto_transcribe: true` when cues/SRT are not supplied and you want spoken dialogue in the video transcribed automatically with word/segment timings. When authoring `cues` directly, split the script into multiple short cues (typically 1.5–4 seconds each, ~1–8 words per cue, roughly 15–20 characters per second of cue duration) — never burn a single cue that spans the entire clip. If the user explicitly asks you to write, invent, improvise, or make up captions/subtitles rather than transcribing spoken audio, create a few short cue lines yourself and pass `cues`.

sourceVideoIndex.description: Which video to subtitle. Default: -1 (most recent generated or uploaded video). Non-negative values are 0-based indices into prior generated video results. Negative values reference uploaded videos.

cues.description: Ordered subtitle cues. Each cue has startSeconds, endSeconds, and the line of text to display. Provide `cues`, `srt`, or `auto_transcribe: true`. Aim for multiple short cues (1.5–4s each, ~1–8 words) rather than one long cue spanning the full clip.

srt.description: Full SRT (or VTT) document as a string, used in place of `cues`. Useful when the user pastes a subtitle file directly. Provide `cues`, `srt`, or `auto_transcribe: true`.

auto_transcribe.description: When true and neither `cues` nor `srt` is supplied, automatically transcribes the video's spoken audio with speech-to-text word/segment timings and burns paced subtitle cues onto the video.

style.description: Optional styling overrides for the burned subtitles.

fontSizePct.description: Font size as a percentage of the video height. Default 6.

position.description: Vertical placement of the subtitle line. Default "bottom".
